Good things take time
Dec 2019
A lot of complaints about the wait time. I agree but IHMO that is why the food is always so good. They cook to order - perhaps a few pieces ahead but not a stack of pre-cooked barbequed meat dumped into a bain marie in the corner.

Best Com Ga I have ever had - chicken was succulent and perfectly cooked, the broken rice well spiced and the salsa to die for.

Do Not Go if you are in a rush. If you have time, one of the tastiest, juiciest and friendly places around, Just be warned that it IS popular and the food is barbecued to order. There is a McDonald's not far away if you need fast food. Otherwise, kick back and watch the street life and savor the delicious smells - worth the wait!

Good food,wait time too long.
Oct 2019 • Friends
We were originally told the lamb cutlet dish would take 15 to 20 minutes to cook which we were happy to wait for. After 40 minutes we were told it would be another 20 minutes! None of our orders arrived for another 20 or so minutes...A total of 1 and a half hours from when we ordered. The last of our meals (carbonara spaghetti)arrived after most had finished their meals. 
Even though we were seated before all but one table upstairs we were last served which only added to our disappointment. 
Food, once it arrived, was tasty and staff were courteous. 
Maybe the chef needs some training in coordinating meals to arrive on time so all guests get to eat together. Our group of 6 left very unhappy. Even though a 3% discount was offered one couple ended up paying full price. 
A very unenjoyable meal and unless the cooking times can be sped up wouldn't recommend this restaurant.
